instruction: Go to the Counter-Strike: Global Offensive store page and add Operation Pass DLC to the shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding CS:GO in Steam store and adding Operation Pass DLC to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Item name mismatch - instruction asks for 'Operation Pass DLC' but evaluator checks for 'CS:GO - Operation Riptide' which is a specific operation pass, not necessarily the one found when following the instruction
Verification logic is too simplistic - metric only does substring search in page content without verifying the item is actually in the cart section (not in ads, descriptions, etc.)
Expected value may not match actual Steam cart HTML rendering - 'CS:GO - Operation Riptide' might appear differently in the cart
No consideration for Steam's dynamic content, authentication requirements, or page load states
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix the expected item name to match what actually appears when following the instruction - either update instruction to specify 'Operation Riptide' or update expected to match the generic 'Operation Pass' that would be found
Improve is_added_to_steam_cart metric to parse cart HTML structure and verify item is in the actual cart items list, not just anywhere on the page
Add postconfig to ensure user is logged into Steam if required for cart operations
Consider using more robust selectors to extract cart items from Steam's cart page structure (e.g., CSS selectors for cart item elements)
